comments.text:
Since not many ppl know this but

The secret ending means that when she died, she was gathered around by the other sacrificed souls, and they gently placed a hand on her, as as she went into the water. It's supposed to mean that the other spirits helped her feel at peace with what just happened to her, and instead of raging like in the main ending, she's at peace and her soul moves on.

The main ending (or OG)
 She is betrayed and she dies, but her soul becomes enraged, causing her to start the punishment that was bestowed upon the four children who threw her in, making every single one of them go through hell in a loop, including her
